title: Getting Started
text: bs4Dashkit extends bs4Dash standardizing branding, sidebar behavior, navbar utilities, theme customization. Every feature optional — can adopt little much need. package organised around four areas: Brand sidebar — dash_titles() + use_bs4Dashkit_core() Theming — use_dash_theme() named presets Navbar — dash_nav_title(), refresh / help / logout buttons, user menu Footer — dash_footer() flexible logo text positioning

title: Getting Started
text: smallest possible bs4Dashkit app requires exactly two calls beyond normal bs4Dash boilerplate: dash_titles() accepts single string sensible defaults handle everything else. use_bs4Dashkit_core() loads CSS dependencies, activates sidebar brand mode, applies default theme.
code: library(shiny) library(bs4Dash) library(bs4Dashkit)  # 1. Build the brand object ttl <- dash_titles("My Dashboard")  ui <- bs4DashPage(   title   = ttl$app_name,           # browser tab title   header  = bs4DashNavbar(title = ttl$brand),   sidebar = bs4DashSidebar(),   body    = bs4DashBody(     use_bs4Dashkit_core(ttl)        # 2. always the first call in body and called once   ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {} shinyApp(ui, server)

text: Creates pre-styled actionButton() intended navbar. Server wiring: common behavior full app refresh: prefer “soft refresh”, can invalidate reactive chains instead (example, updating reactive counter). pattern app-specific.
code: dash_nav_refresh_button("refresh")                      # default label + icon dash_nav_refresh_button("refresh", label = "Reload")    # custom label dash_nav_refresh_button("refresh", label = "")          # icon only dash_nav_refresh_button("refresh", icon = "arrows-rotate") observeEvent(input$refresh, {   session$reload() })

title: Navigation Utilities
text: Creates pre-styled actionButton() intended open help content. Server wiring simple help modal: structured help modal:
code: dash_nav_help_button("help")                     # default label + icon dash_nav_help_button("help", label = "Support")  # custom label dash_nav_help_button("help", label = "")         # icon only dash_nav_help_button("help", icon = "circle-info") observeEvent(input$help, {   showModal(modalDialog(     title     = "Help",     "Add your instructions here.",     easyClose = TRUE,     footer    = modalButton("Close")   )) }) observeEvent(input$help, {   showModal(modalDialog(     title = "Help & Documentation",     tagList(       h4("Getting started"),       p("Describe the dashboard purpose here."),       h4("Data sources"),       p("Describe where data comes from."),       h4("Contact"),       p("Email: support@yourorg.gov")     ),     size      = "l",     easyClose = TRUE,     footer    = modalButton("Close")   )) })

title: Navigation Utilities
text: Creates pre-styled actionButton() intended trigger application-defined sign-flow. Server wiring (example pattern) Sign-behavior application-specific (authentication, redirects, session cleanup). typical UI pattern confirmation modal:
code: dash_nav_logout_button("logout") observeEvent(input$logout, {   showModal(modalDialog(     title  = "Sign out",     "Are you sure you want to sign out?",     footer = tagList(       modalButton("Cancel"),       actionButton("logout_confirm", "Sign out",                     class = "btn btn-danger")     ),     easyClose = TRUE   )) })  observeEvent(input$logout_confirm, {   removeModal()   # Your sign-out logic goes here (auth/session cleanup/redirect).   session$reload() })

title: Navigation Utilities
text: Server:
code: bs4DashNavbar(   title = ttl$brand,   skin  = "light",   rightUi = tagList(     dash_nav_title(       "DASHBOARDS",       "Critical & Main",       icon  = "shield-halved",       align = "center"     ),     dash_nav_item(dash_nav_refresh_button("refresh")),     dash_nav_item(dash_nav_help_button("help")),     dash_nav_item(dash_nav_logout_button("logout")),     dash_nav_item(       dash_user_menu(         dropdownMenu(           type = "notifications",           notificationItem("Profile"),           notificationItem("Sign out")         )       )     )   ) ) server <- function(input, output, session) {   observeEvent(input$refresh, session$reload())    observeEvent(input$help, {     showModal(modalDialog("Help content.", easyClose = TRUE))   })    observeEvent(input$logout, {     showModal(modalDialog(       title  = "Sign out",       "Are you sure?",       footer = tagList(         modalButton("Cancel"),         actionButton("logout_confirm", "Sign out", class = "btn btn-danger")       )     ))   })    observeEvent(input$logout_confirm, {     removeModal()     session$reload()   }) }

title: Create sidebar / navbar brand UI — dash_brand_ui
text: brand_text Visible brand label (character) icon Font Awesome icon name e.g. "shield-halved". NULL none. icon_img URL www-relative path image logo. Overrides icon supplied. icon_shape Shape mask image icons: "circle", "rounded", "square". Ignored FA icons. Default "circle". icon_size Size icon/image CSS string e.g. "20px", "1.3em". NULL = inherits sidebar default. icon_color CSS color FA icon e.g. "#2f6f8f". NULL = inherit. image icons, applies CSS tint via mix-blend-mode (subtle). weight CSS font-weight: numeric keyword. Default 700. spacing CSS letter-spacing. Default "-0.02em". size CSS font-size label e.g. "13px". NULL = inherit. italic Logical. Italicise label. Default FALSE. font_family CSS font-family string e.g. "'Inter', sans-serif". color Solid CSS color label text. NULL = inherit. Ignored gradient set. gradient Character vector 2 hex colors gradient text effect e.g. c("#2f6f8f", "#5ba3c9"). Automatically enables effect = "gradient". effect Visual effect label: "none", "glow", "shimmer", "emboss". "gradient" set automatically gradient supplied. glow_color CSS color glow effect. Defaults first gradient color color package accent blue.

title: Dashboard brand and sidebar configuration — dash_titles
text: brand_text Visible brand label shown navbar/sidebar. app_name Browser tab title. NULL, defaults brand_text. icon Font Awesome icon name brand (e.g. "project-diagram"). Ignored icon_img supplied. icon_img Path (www relative) URL image logo. Overrides icon. icon_shape Shape mask image logos. One "circle", "rounded", "square". icon_size CSS size icon/image (e.g. "20px", "1.2em"). icon_color CSS color Font Awesome icon. image icons, subtle tint may applied. weight CSS font-weight brand text. spacing CSS letter-spacing brand text. size CSS font-size brand text (e.g. "14px"). italic Logical. TRUE, renders brand text italics. font_family CSS font-family string (e.g. "'Inter', sans-serif"). color Solid CSS text color brand label (ignored gradient set). gradient Character vector length 2 giving gradient colors brand label. set, gradient styling applied. effect Visual effect brand label. One "none", "glow", "shimmer", "emboss". gradient set, gradient styling used. glow_color Color used glow/shimmer effects (applicable). collapsed Sidebar brand mode sidebar collapsed. One "icon-", "icon-text", "text-". NULL, uses option bs4Dashkit.sidebar.collapsed. expanded Sidebar brand mode sidebar expanded. One "icon-", "icon-text", "text-". NULL, uses option bs4Dashkit.sidebar.expanded. collapsed_text Short label used collapsed mode (recommended <= 8 chars). expanded_text Label used expanded mode (recommended <= 30 chars). brand_divider Logical. TRUE, shows divider brand block. NULL, uses option bs4Dashkit.brand_divider. debug Logical. TRUE, emits console warnings missing icons, etc. NULL, uses option bs4Dashkit.debug.

title: bs4Dashkit 0.1.0
text: Added dash_titles() unified constructor brand sidebar configuration. Returns $app_name, $brand, $deps placement bs4DashPage(), bs4DashNavbar(), bs4DashBody(). Added use_bs4Dashkit_core() recommended entry point injecting dependencies, applying theme preset, configuring sidebar behavior. Added theme support via CSS custom properties: Presets: "professional", "vibrant", "minimal" use_dash_theme() direct CSS variable overrides use_dash_theme_preset() applying named presets theme_presets() inspecting available presets Added configurable sidebar brand modes: “icon-”, "icon-text", "text-" Independent configuration collapsed expanded states Added use_dash_sidebar_behavior() configurable collapsed width, expanded width, topbar height. Added use_dash_sidebar_brand_divider() optional brand/menu separation. Added brand visual effects ("glow", "shimmer", "emboss") two-color gradients via dash_titles(). Added support image-based brand icons via icon_img icon_shape. Added navbar utilities: dash_nav_title() dash_nav_item() dash_nav_refresh_button() dash_nav_help_button() dash_user_menu() Added dash_footer()independently positional logo text elements. Added global options: bs4Dashkit.sidebar.collapsed bs4Dashkit.sidebar.expanded bs4Dashkit.brand_divider bs4Dashkit.theme_preset bs4Dashkit.accent
